About.1: Full-time video-based courses in every difficulty
About.4: Completely for free, if you're helping

1.Heading: Video-based courses
1.Body: We offer free and paid courses. Our courses contain almost everything that is taught when studying computer science. And we're working hard to erase the 'almost'.

2.Heading: Webinars
2.Body: Sometimes, there are questions, sometimes, we need someone to tell us about their work. That's why we have webinars. Held by you for you. Held by experts for those who want to become one.

3.Heading: Coaching
3.Body: You do want that individual help, you want an expert mentoring just you? Here you go!

4.Heading: Exercises
4.Body: We all love a challenges. That's why we already have a lot of coding challenges for you. But there's a lot more to come!

5.Heading: The Skill Tree
5.Body: Have you ever stood before the vast amount of coding languages and technologies and did not have the slightest idea what to learn next? That's why we designed a roadmap: The skilltree!

6.Heading: Certificates
6.Body: To apply for jobs or just for trophy hunting, there are real certificates. You don't get those for participating but for a real exam. We're working with colleges and companies to larger the benefit - and our network is growing.

1.Heading: How can I participate? How can I get MorphCoins?
1.Body: There are several possibilities to help us - and get coins: You can help me with a certain video, you can host a webinar, become a coach or you can help us with finding and repairing bugs. Additionally, you can buy MorphCoins directly via PayPal, SEPA direct debit, giropay, and debit/credit card. All payment methods are processed through PayPal. More details are

2.Heading: Is MorphCoin a cryptocurrency?
2.Body: No. It is a pure site-internal currency.

3.Heading: Your vlogs are not a skill here. Why?
3.Body: We're planning for integrating a whole new part for learning security awareness, but we did not want to keep everyone waiting. If you have some cool ideas, feel free to contact me.

4.Heading: I want to host a webinar. How?
4.Body: You first need to get that skill certified, so we can be sure, you actually know, what you're talking about. Then you need a certificate for some soft skills. After that, you can at any time you like.

5.Heading: I already studied computer science. Can I get my skills certified?
5.Body: Sure. Contact us! We need to do that manually so we know, it's true. That's why we need a few MorphCoins for it.

1.Heading: Buy MorphCoins
1.Body: You can buy MorphCoins using euros in the shop. This is possible directly via PayPal, SEPA direct debit, giropay, and debit/credit card. All payment methods are processed through PayPal.

2.Heading: Lectures
2.Body: Provide everything for a lecture. You still have that code of your last python project where you use cool libs? Or you just installed something on your server and created screenshots or even a video of every step you took? Send it over and I'll share it with the community. However, please be aware that this info will be public then! So you're transferring rights to me, meaning you first have to have those! So please, only original work. And if I have to fix too many bugs, I'll have to reduce your reward.

3.Heading: Webinars
3.Body: Host webinars as an instructor. You're an expert and want to share your knowledge in webinars? Contact me, if you've got the skills, I'm happy to have you. You yourself decide about the prices you take from the participants. You keep 80%! Only limitation: The webinar may not be for free - you know, we do want to keep developing this site.

4.Heading: Coach
4.Body: Apply and become a coach. Want to help people individually? You only need the skills you want to coach, some soft skills and you can start. Rates are totally up to you!

5.Heading: Bug Bounty
5.Body: Find Bugs of any sorts and report those. You're hacker or you just found a bug, a security vulnerability or a mistake in text or ordering of any sorts? Use the Icon on the right to report it to us! Depending on the severity, you get a reward. Disclaimer: You may NOT use any services, that might crash the server or network or count as denial of service tools! All data you might have access to, need to be removed immediately(!) and completely from your systems. Data on our systems may NOT be changed! Please try to keep other user out of this, try and exploit yourselves, if it is a user based exploit. Also, please limit yourselves to the Bootstrap Academy. Everything that's not from the academy is out of scope. Example: We use Youtube videos, but we don't own Youtube, so it's out of scope. Also: Only the first reporter will be rewarded and if you are a third party provider, there will probably be no reward. Speaking of rewards: Rewards are most commonly paid out in morphcoins. The amount is defined by the severity of the bug and the quality of the report and how easy you make it for us to fix it. In cases where we discussed that you do bug hunting for us, a payout in euro is possible. Please contact us, if you want this BEFORE you search for a bug!

Claims.Title: Accounting and outstanding claims
Claims.Limit: This view shows records already stored. It is not a complete final statement and does not calculate a total cash refund.
Claims.Error: The information could not be loaded. Previously displayed data has been removed. Your rights remain.
Claims.NoCase: No accounting case is available in this view yet. This does not mean that no claims exist.
Claims.Received: Original receipt of the erasure request
Claims.ReceiptLimit: A receipt does not confirm completed erasure, a payment or a waiver of claims.
Claims.NoRecords: This view does not yet contain individual claim records.
Claims.ReservationLimit: A reservation or recorded completion alone is not proof of payment. This view does not provide a complete account of later wallet movements.
Claims.PaymentLimit: These are staff records of external outcomes, not provider verification by this page. Each payment lists only its allocated settlement parts; other parts can remain open.
Claims.DocumentError: The original could not be retrieved for this access. No replacement file was generated. Please contact us to resolve this.
Claims.Contact: For questions about your case or documents not shown here:

State.rejected: Item recorded as rejected; further rights remain
State.reserved: Reserved for settlement; no confirmed outcome yet
State.completed: Settlement completion recorded; payment evidence is separate

EventCancellation.Unavailable: The selected scope could not be loaded. No cancellation has been declared here.

Scope.booking: Only your displayed booking is selected ({count} order).
Scope.session: The whole displayed session is selected, including its {count} current orders.

Role.participant: You are declaring cancellation of your participation.
Role.provider: You are declaring cancellation as the current provider.
Role.administrator: You are intervening as an administrator. This is not a provider or participant declaration.

EventCancellation.Price: Original recorded booking amount: {coins} Morphcoins. This is not a refund confirmation.
EventCancellation.PriceUnknown: The original booking amount is not fully established. It is not recorded as zero.

Later declarations and greater applicable rights require assessment; this confirmation does not establish forfeiture or a partial refund.
EventCancellation.ProviderWaiver: If you cancel this exact session as its current provider, the existing waiver makes the next covered booking free. Administrator intervention does not create that provider waiver.
EventCancellation.AdministrationDeclaration: I declare an administrative cancellation of exactly the session and current order count displayed above, for the reason entered.
EventCancellation.Declaration: I cancel exactly the booking or session and order count displayed above.

State.received: Your declaration is recorded. Processing of the selected scope is still pending.
State.applied: The selected scope has been cancelled and its capacity released.
State.resolution_required: Your declaration is recorded, but the prepared scope could not be applied. Booking changes have not been made by this declaration. The original scope requires resolution.

Financial.not_assessed: Financial claims have not yet been assessed.
Financial.amount_unknown: The amount still requires original payment evidence.
Financial.requires_review: Entitlement or the covered components still require assessment.
Financial.uncertain: The financial outcome is uncertain and requires reconciliation.
Financial.recorded_zero: The recorded claim amount is zero. This is not a statement about other rights.
Financial.historical_application: A historical credit application is recorded. Satisfaction of all financial claims is not established by this notice.
Financial.pending: The recorded financial claim is still pending.

EventCancellation.PaymentSeparate: This receipt does not confirm a completed refund or cash payment.
EventCancellation.NoticeAccepted: The email service accepted the notice. Recipient delivery is not confirmed.
EventCancellation.NoticePending: Email acceptance has not been confirmed. The recorded declaration and booking outcome remain available here.

ClaimAccess.Title: Access to existing claims
ClaimAccess.Explanation: Use your claim key to read existing records and replace the key. You do not need a new account or contract.
ClaimAccess.RecoveryFile: Contents of your saved recovery file
ClaimAccess.RotationEffect: Replacing the key invalidates previous claim keys and learning access credentials. Existing claims, contracts and learning assignments remain. You can refresh access for an existing learning space separately below.
ClaimAccess.KeepRecovery: Keep this file private. It contains your new key and lets you continue this replacement if a response is missing. The browser only keeps it for this tab.
ClaimAccess.Saved: I have safely saved the recovery file.
ClaimAccess.MissingProof: If you do not have a current key, you can use an existing personal password or linked OAuth proof. A saved replacement key alone only works if it was activated and is still current.
ClaimAccess.ContactLimit: Recovery without personal proof and contact address changes are not available here yet. Case correspondence access does not replace that proof. For an inquiry:

State.prepared: The new key is prepared. The replacement has not been sent.
State.unconfirmed: The replacement outcome is unconfirmed. Keep your saved file and continue the same replacement.
State.recorded: The replacement was confirmed. Whether its key currently works could not yet be checked.
State.active: The new key was checked and is currently valid. Keep it safe.
State.inactive: The earlier replacement is confirmed, but its key is no longer valid. Use your current personal proof.

Error.proof_required: Current personal proof is required. A missing response may mean that only the saved replacement key works. Existing recovery material is preserved.
Error.no_case: No existing commercial case was found for this proof. This does not mean you have no rights. Use current personal proof to check whether a case can be opened.
Error.invalid_recovery: This recovery file cannot be read. Keep the unchanged original.
Error.pending_request: A prepared or unconfirmed replacement is still open. Continue that replacement first.
Error.replacement_inactive: The replacement is confirmed, but its key is not currently valid. Use current personal proof; the saved replacement is preserved.
Error.request_failed: The operation could not be confirmed. Keep the key and recovery file and retry the same operation.

LearningAccess.Title: Separate learning access
LearningAccess.Scope: Create separate learning access or refresh the key for your existing access. Your existing rights remain. This does not trigger a purchase or renewal.
LearningAccess.Subject: Learning space
LearningAccess.NoElection: No active learning access is currently listed. You can prepare a new one; it will be created only if none is active when the request is processed.
LearningAccess.Recovery: Contents of your saved learning file
LearningAccess.Keep: Keep this file private. It contains a learning key and the exact request needed after a missing response. The browser keeps it only for this tab.
LearningAccess.Saved: I have saved the learning file safely.
LearningAccess.Unconfirmed: Current learning access has not been confirmed.
LearningAccess.Available: The learning key and current resource access were checked.
LearningAccess.Expired: This learning key is no longer confirmed as usable. Use current personal proof to check existing learning access. Your saved request remains unchanged.
LearningAccess.ProofRequired: Use current personal proof and continue the saved request. A learning key cannot issue another key.
LearningAccess.SubjectChanged: The selected learning space could not be confirmed. Keep the saved request; no other learning space will be selected for it.
LearningAccess.Failed: Access could not be confirmed. Keep the saved file and continue the same request with current personal proof.
LearningAccess.IntegrationLimit: Courses currently available to this learning space can be opened below. Existing course rights can be continued separately above. Exercises are not connected here yet.
LearningAccess.StartChoice: Create new, separate learning access only if none is active when this request is processed. This request will not select an access space that became active in the meantime.
LearningAccess.StartRefused: The creation request was refused. Keep the saved request for exact recovery. Show existing learning access to select one explicitly for a separate key refresh.
LearningAccess.RefreshRefused: The saved refresh request was refused. Keep its original file. Check existing learning access and explicitly choose a separate refresh or, if none is active, prepare new access.

RetainedCourses.Title: Courses in this learning space
RetainedCourses.Scope: Open courses currently available to this learning space. Opening a course does not buy it or change an existing contract.
RetainedCourses.Empty: No courses are currently listed for this learning space.
RetainedCourses.ProgressUncertain: The completion result is uncertain. Check the recorded progress before trying again.
RetainedCourses.CompletionUnconfirmed: The current course record does not show this lecture as completed. You can try marking it again.
RetainedCourses.Unavailable: The course or current access could not be confirmed. Check access and try again.
RetainedCourses.MediaUnavailable: The video could not be loaded. Reload it to check current access and obtain a fresh link.
RetainedCourses.YouTubePrivacy: YouTube connects only when you choose to load this lecture. Your choice applies to this lecture on this visit.

CourseContinuation.Title: Continue an existing course right
CourseContinuation.Scope: Choose an existing course right and the separate learning space where you want to continue it. This does not buy a course, accept new terms or start a renewal.
CourseContinuation.NoSources: No erased source is recorded here. Missing observations do not establish that no rights exist.
CourseContinuation.NoTarget: Create or refresh a separate learning space above before preparing a new continuation. Saved requests can still be recovered here.
CourseContinuation.NoRights: No course-right observations are recorded for this source in this response. Other existing rights may require review.
CourseContinuation.StartedAccess: Existing access from a previously started course was recorded.
CourseContinuation.ObservationLimit: This observation does not establish a purchase, original performance or a new access period.
CourseContinuation.Recovery: Contents of your saved course continuation file
CourseContinuation.Keep: Save this exact request before sending it. Keep its original course, source and target for recovery after a missing reply.
CourseContinuation.Saved: I have saved the course request file.
CourseContinuation.Retry: Retry the exact saved course request
CourseContinuation.Unconfirmed: No current result is confirmed for this saved request.
CourseContinuation.Refused: This request was refused and no matching command was recorded in the current check. You can make a separate explicit selection; the original request stays saved.
CourseContinuation.CurrentAccessLimit: A recorded result is separate from current course access. Use the protected course view below to check what is available now.
CourseContinuation.HistoricalSuccess: This receipt records an earlier successful delivery. It does not restore withdrawn access or establish current access.
CourseContinuation.RefreshCourses: Clear the old course view and check courses below
CourseContinuation.Failed: The course request or current records could not be confirmed. Keep the saved request and retry or check its recorded status.
CourseContinuation.Pending: Resolve the exact saved request before preparing another command.
CourseContinuation.Existing: A command for this right and target already exists. Choose its original recovery action.
CourseContinuation.Changed: The selected source, right or target changed. Check the current records and make a separate selection.

State.reserved: The selection is recorded; delivery is pending.
State.uncertain: The selection is recorded; its delivery result is uncertain.
State.granted: Successful delivery is recorded. Check current course access below.
State.withdrawn: Continuation to this learning space is withdrawn. Original records remain.
State.rejected: Continuation was rejected. Original rights remain.

CaseOpen.Title: Open a case for existing matters
CaseOpen.Explanation: No commercial case is currently listed for your personal proof. This does not mean you have no rights. Opening a case preserves related records for review. It does not change your ordinary account access, start a purchase or create learning access.
CaseOpen.Keep: The browser keeps the original request for this tab. You can optionally save it as a file to continue the same request later. Current personal proof is still required; this file is not an access key.
CaseOpen.File: Contents of your saved case-opening file

State.unconfirmed: This case-opening request is not yet confirmed. Keep its reference and check the same request. An independently available case does not confirm this particular request.
State.recorded: This case-opening request was recorded for the checked case. Its records are still subject to review.

Error.proof_required: Use current personal proof again. The original case-opening request remains saved.
Error.invalid_recovery: This case-opening file cannot be used. Keep the unchanged original.
Error.pending_request: A case-opening request is still unconfirmed. Check the same request first.
Error.request_failed: The case-opening request or current case could not be confirmed. Keep the original request and check it again with current personal proof.

PremiumContinuation.Title: Continue an existing Premium period
PremiumContinuation.Scope: Select a recorded original Premium period and the learning access where it should continue. Its original dates stay unchanged. This does not make a purchase or activate renewal.
PremiumContinuation.Empty: No preserved Premium-period observations are listed here. This does not establish that no rights exist.
PremiumContinuation.NoTarget: No current learning access is listed. Existing requests can still be recovered below.
PremiumContinuation.Choice: Continue only this original period to this selected learning access, with the original dates unchanged.
PremiumContinuation.Prepared: The original period and selected learning access are ready for review. The continuation has not been sent.
PremiumContinuation.Unconfirmed: This continuation is not yet confirmed. Keep the original request and check the same command.
PremiumContinuation.Refused: The request was refused. Its original reference remains saved; you can make another deliberate selection.
PremiumContinuation.WithdrawnHistory: A withdrawal was already observed for this continuation and remains part of its history.
PremiumContinuation.Historical: The saved result records the original continuation. It does not confirm that learning access is currently usable.
PremiumContinuation.Restore: Optional Premium request file and recovery
PremiumContinuation.Keep: The browser saves the exact request for this tab. You may also save a file for later recovery. This file contains no new access key and still requires current personal proof.
PremiumContinuation.Recovery: Contents of your saved Premium continuation file
PremiumContinuation.CurrentActive: The checked Premium period is active within its recorded dates.
PremiumContinuation.CurrentNotActive: An active Premium period is not currently confirmed by this resource check.
PremiumContinuation.CurrentLimit: This resource check may show a different, independently longer period. Its dates are separate from the original continuation above.
PremiumContinuation.NoResources: No current learning-resource check is available here. The original continuation and its recovery remain available through personal proof.
PremiumContinuation.Pending: An original continuation is still pending. Continue that exact request first.
PremiumContinuation.Existing: A continuation already exists for this original observation and target. Recover its recorded request.
PremiumContinuation.Changed: The original period or selected learning access could not be confirmed for a new continuation. Reload the records; saved requests stay unchanged.
PremiumContinuation.Failed: This request or its current records could not be confirmed. Keep the original request and retry with current personal proof.

State.active: The original period continuation is recorded. Current use requires a separate resource check.
State.withdrawn: The target learning access was erased. This recorded continuation remains withdrawn.

PeriodState.current: The original period is within its recorded dates. The server checks whether it can continue when submitted.
PeriodState.future: The original period has not started. Its dates will not be brought forward.
PeriodState.expired: The original period has ended. Its dates will not be extended here.
PeriodState.unavailable: This original period cannot currently be selected.

Originals.Title: Original documents and order records
Originals.Explanation: Read existing originals using your current personal proof. This does not open a case, place an order or change learning access.
Originals.ProofRequired: A current personal proof is required. Reconnect before reading again.
Originals.ReadFailed: The inventory could not be read. This is not an empty inventory. A known order reference can still be checked below.
Originals.Scope: This lists known local records: financial documents for this recipient and orders also linked to their separate learning accesses. Archives and other services were not searched. This is not a complete catalog.
Originals.HistoryIncomplete: The historical ownership inventory is incomplete.
Originals.NoRecords: No records were observed in this local inventory. This does not establish that no originals or rights exist.
Originals.DocumentFailed: The selected original could not be read. No replacement document was selected.
Originals.KnownOrder: You can also check a known original order UUID. The server checks its original ownership; this reference does not grant access.
Originals.StatusFailed: The original order status is unavailable or does not match this selection. Its outcome remains unknown here.
Originals.StatusLimit: These are original offer and processing observations, not a new purchase or proof of current learning access. Mail-server acceptance does not prove receipt. Missing timing evidence does not prove nonperformance.

Relation.same_case_learning_subject: Record for a separate learning access linked to this recipient.

Reader.candidate: An original read can be requested. Its current availability is checked when read.
Reader.unavailable: This recorded reference is currently unavailable.
Reader.archive_unchecked: The archive has not been checked. A read may still be unavailable.

Reason.missing_progress: The original processing record is missing.
Reason.unsupported_identifier: This recorded identifier is not supported by the original reader.
Reason.original_reader_not_admitted: This reference does not currently permit an original download.
Reason.identity_pending_review: The original identity is awaiting review.
Reason.retired_recorded: A disposal process has been recorded for this reference.
Reason.ambiguous_period: More than one record matches this period; no original is selected.
Reason.absent_selected_artifact: The selected original has not been recorded.

Variant.withdrawal: Withdrawal information supplied with the offer
